# Power8GDI custom Copilot agent profiles

Eight GitHub custom-agent definitions are in `.github/agents/`. Each has valid YAML frontmatter and a scope. They are NOT running just because profiles exist.

Repo GitHub Issues are disabled; tasks live at `Power8GDI/workstreams/`. See `ROADMAP.md` for parallel waves and acceptance gates. For GitHub cloud agent visibility, review merging definitions to default branch; the design work stays on `power8gdi-rev-a`.

Official usage: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-on-github/customize-copilot/customize-cloud-agent/create-custom-agents
